blocks.text: Cycloalkanes ke naam utne hi carbon atoms wale alkane ke naam ke saath prefix cyclo- laga kar rakhe jate hain. Figure 11.3 ethylcyclohexane; isopropylcyclohexane (IUPAC 1-methylethylcyclohexane); n-propylcyclohexane (IUPAC propylcyclohexane); aur 1,1,4-trimethylcyclohexane dikhati hai, jahan halqe ko substituents ke liye sab se chhote locants dene ke liye number diya jata hai.

blocks.caption: Naam shuda cycloalkanes (Figure 11.3)

blocks.prompt: Cyclopentane aur pentane ke molecules mein do farq batayein, aur methylcyclohexane ka formula banayein (Quick Check 11.1b, c).
blocks.explanation: Cyclopentane C5H10 ke paanch carbons halqe mein hain aur pentane C5H12 se do hydrogens kam hain, jis ke carbons khuli zanjeer banate hain; halqe mein CH3 sire nahi jabke pentane mein do hain. Methylcyclohexane chhe carbon ka halqa (C6H11) hai jis se ek CH3 juri hai: C7H14.

items: Cycloalkane = cyclo- + utne hi carbons wale alkane ka naam: ethylcyclohexane, (1-methylethyl)cyclohexane, propylcyclohexane, 1,1,4-trimethylcyclohexane.
